code_summary: This script trains the strongest current FM+BPR configuration with long patience and forced per-epoch snapshots via train_lib.run, then builds a holdout protocol over validation users that the menu cannot express: it loads the saved per-epoch predictions if available, or retrains a snapshot-producing FM path using train_lib primitives, searches top-N checkpoint averages on validation half A, evaluates the chosen ensemble on disjoint validation half B with the official evaluate(), and finally writes full-row valid/test scores from the selected ensemble for harness compatibility. Existing menu primitives can average checkpoints, but cannot implement disjoint user-split checkpoint selection logic, which is the essential mechanism being tested here.
